prompt: I have a fresh macOS machine and want to set up Claude Code with Kei. Walk me through using the setup script.
assertions: The response references the scripts/ directory and setup-claude-code.sh.
The response explains the script handles a fresh machine by creating a new runtime installation when none exists.
The response notes that credentials are piped directly from kei bot credential into kei setup and never printed.
The response mentions that verification runs at the end to confirm the setup is valid.
